= =====================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sourendra Pandey
2 05-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioners have made the following prayer in this application :-
"That, the petitioners are invoking the inherent jurisdiction of this Court under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for quashing the order dated 25.11.2016 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Madhubani in Madhubani Town P.S. Case No. 10 of 2014, whereby and whereunder the learned Chief Patna High Court CR.

entities.text: Madhubani Town P.S. Case No. 10 of 2014
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
MISC. No.1213 of 2026(2) dt.05-02-2026 Judicial Magistrate has been pleased to take cognizance for the offences under Sections 406,
409, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code against the petitioners."

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the primarily allegation against the petitioners is that she being the Panchayat Mukhiya did not complete the certain works and the amount had been misappropriated.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that the petitioners had been granted protection during her anticipatory bail application and during such period, she got the work completed for which the money had been received.
It has further been submitted that now the petitioners have also been granted the No Objection Certificate on 04.01.2025 by the authority certifying the fact that the work has indeed been done.

4. In view of the aforesaid submission, let a counter affidavit be filed on behalf of the learned A.P.P.
for the State within four weeks.

5. List this case on 12.03.2026 at 2:15 P.M., under appropriate heading.
6.

In the meantime, further proceeding of the learned Court below in connection with Madhubani Town P. S. Case No. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.1213 of 2026(2) dt.05-02-2026 10 of 2014,
shall remain stayed with respect to the petitioners till further order.
